newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,079.60.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,079.60.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended down against the dollar at 1,079.60 but well off its intraday low after mostly sideways trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said on Thursday.
Dealers said the peso's 1.10 slip from Wednesday's close reflected speculation in the aftermath of the central bank's decision on Tuesday to tighten reserve requirements for foreign loans.
The measure is aimed at reducing foreign currency inflows, which boosted the peso to an artifically high trading level late last year.
Dealers reported 375 trades for a total of $184 million and said the peso fell as low at 1,082.10 before trending higher into the close.
